name: refactor_js_switch_to_lookup_table
description: Three parallel switch statements -> one config lookup table; drift broken fat-fingers a rate while transcribing
prompts: shipping.js dispatches on the same three shipping methods with three parallel switch statements - cost, delivery estimate, and label all repeat the case list, and adding a method means touching all three. Refactor to a single lookup table: one const object mapping each method to its data (base cost, per-kg rate, estimate, label), with the three exported functions reading from it and NO switch statements left in the file. Watch the lookup: an unknown method must still throw a RangeError from all three functions - including inputs like 'toString' or 'constructor' that exist on Object.prototype (guard with an own-property check, a null-prototype object, or a Map). Pure refactor otherwise: every cost, estimate, and label byte-identical, and module.exports unchanged.
